lines.en: Camila, you’re out at last! What did the doctor say?
lines.pt: Camila, você saiu enfim! O que a médica disse?

lines.en: She said I could go home today, but I couldn’t go to work.
lines.pt: Ela disse que eu podia ir para casa hoje, mas não podia ir trabalhar.

lines.en: Did she say anything about your arm? Does it still hurt?
lines.pt: Ela disse algo sobre o seu braço? Ainda dói?

lines.en: She said the arm was fine, and she said I could use it a little.
lines.pt: Ela disse que o braço estava bem e que eu podia usá-lo um pouco.

lines.en: Good. And what did she say about the medicine?
lines.pt: Bom. E o que ela disse sobre o remédio?

lines.en: She told me I should take one tablet at night and that I could eat normally.
lines.pt: Ela me disse que eu devia tomar um comprimido à noite e que podia comer normalmente.

lines.en: Did she say when you should come back?
lines.pt: Ela disse quando você deve voltar?

lines.en: Yes, she said I should come back next week. She also said I could swim again in a month.
lines.pt: Sim, disse que eu devia voltar na semana que vem. Disse também que eu podia nadar de novo em um mês.

lines.en: That’s great news. Did she say you could drive?
lines.pt: Que ótima notícia. Ela disse que você podia dirigir?

lines.en: She said I couldn’t drive for three days. So she told me to take a taxi.
lines.pt: Ela disse que eu não podia dirigir por três dias. Então me disse para pegar um táxi.

lines.en: No problem, I’ll take you home. Tell your mother what the doctor said.
lines.pt: Sem problema, levo você para casa. Conte à sua mãe o que a médica disse.

facts.big: She said I could go home
facts.label: said + could
facts.sub: Depois de said ou told me no passado, can vira could. Use said that ou told me that para contar o que o médico disse.

facts.label: disse que podia
facts.sub: No discurso indireto, can vira could quando o verbo de dizer está no passado: She said I could go home. Mantenha o resto da frase simples e no passado.

facts.label: disse-me
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa: She told me I should rest. Não use said me. Com said, a pessoa não vem logo depois: She said I should rest. Told sempre pede me, him, her ou us.

compare.ask: She said I could go home.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “a médica disse que eu podia ir para casa”.
compare.tip: Diga: “She said I could go home.”
compare.us: Em inglês, depois de said no passado, can vira could: She said I could go home. Com told, use uma pessoa: She told me I could go home.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: In reported speech, can often becomes could.
items.why: She said I could go home.

items.s: She said I can go home is the usual report in the past.
Told is followed by a person.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: In reported speech, can often becomes could. → Verdadeiro (She said I could go home.)
She said I can go home is the usual report in the past. → Falso (Use could after said.)
Told is followed by a person. → Verdadeiro (She told me…)

pages.title: Outside a clinic in Perth · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a warm afternoon in Perth. Ben had an appointment at a clinic. He had pain in his arm last week. Now he left the doctor’s office. His friend Fay came to pick him up. She wants to hear every detail.

“Ben, you’re out at last! What did the doctor say?” says Fay. “She said I could go home today, but I couldn’t go to work.” says Ben. “Did she say anything about your arm? Does it still hurt?” says Fay.
